text.en:
Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Currency
(Denominations and Characteristics of Coins) (No. 6)
Notification 2013
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 1st January 2014 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date “2014” below it and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coins. A ring of dashes surrounds the Singapore Arms on both the 10‑cent and 50‑cent coins. The $1 coin has an octagonal frame along the circumference. The $5 coin has a ring of beads surrounding the Singapore Arms with a latent image below it depicting the year‑date “2014” and MAS logo.
